scenario.organization_context: B2B SaaS company, 150 employees. Sales reps regularly receive shipment and client gift delivery notices.

simulation.subject: Action Required: Outstanding Delivery Fee for Client Appreciation Hamper
simulation.body:
Dear Sales Representative,

We attempted to deliver a high-priority client appreciation hamper to your office address on behalf of your account portfolio, but the delivery could not be completed due to an unpaid regional handling charge of $4.50.

To ensure your gift reaches your client without further delay, please settle the outstanding delivery fee immediately using our secure portal below:

[SIMULATED LINK: http://courier-services-sim.local/pay-fee?id=99281]

Please note that shipments are held for a maximum of 24 hours before being returned to the sender. Your prompt attention to this matter is greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
Express Courier Services
